# Fetch all habit-tracker notes, sorted by creation time ascending
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzaW1wbGVfbm90ZStreWxfbW9vckBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODQ0MTIwOTh9.381R4fpkLxIJObrasON3x0TE_j4Hs65Svg7UDCIT8Tk'
all_habit_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, tags=["habit-tracker"], page_limit=20, page_index=page_index, sort_by="+created_at")
    if not page:
        break
    all_habit_notes.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total habit-tracker notes: {len(all_habit_notes)}")
print("First few note IDs and titles:")
for note in all_habit_notes[:5]:
    print(note)
